title: Science Corporation implants its vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient
hook_text: Science Corporation implanted a vision chip
script:
Science Corporation just implanted a vision-restoring chip in a Stargardt disease patient.
Max Hodak, the former president of Neuralink, is leading this clinical effort.
The team uses the PRIMA system to bypass damaged retinal cells.
Stargardt disease causes progressive vision loss with no current standard treatments.
Hodak detailed the breakthrough at TechCrunch Disrupt this week.
This implant is a step toward developing high-resolution BCI technology.
Would you let a chip connect directly to your brain?

LINE 7: Change to 'Would you trust a BCI to restore your sight?'
